description.value: Fifteen adults with MDD and 15 healthy participants, matched for age, verbal IQ and smoking habits, were investigated in a functional magnetic resonance imaging (fMRI) study using a monetary incentive delay task. Patients were scanned drug-free and after 6 weeks of open-label treatment with escitalopram; controls were scanned twice at corresponding time points.

value: There was a significant group-by-time interaction during anticipation of loss in the left ventral striatum, due to an increase in signal in MDD patients after treatment.
During gain anticipation, the group-by-time interaction in the left ventral striatum was only trendwise significant.
The interaction pattern supports normalization of diminished ventral striatal responsiveness after successful treatment with escitalopram, particularly for loss anticipation.
